headline: Growth accelerates as Samsara turns profitable
summary_short: Samsara reported FY2026 Q2 revenue of $478.8M, up 30.5% y/y and 7.8% q/q, with net income turning positive at $44.5M versus a $22.1M loss a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue of $478.8M rose 30.5% y/y and 7.8% q/q. Gross profit of $361.1M grew 27.3% y/y and 6.7% q/q, though gross margin narrowed slightly from about 77.3% a year ago to 75.4% today. Operating income (EBIT) was $7.2M, reversing a $33.3M loss a year ago but down $1.8M q/q from $9.0M. EBITDA of $15.1M swung from a $28.1M loss y/y but slipped $1.3M q/q from $16.5M. Net income of $44.5M reversed a $22.1M loss a year ago and more than doubled q/q from $22.0M. Diluted EPS of $0.08 turned positive from -$0.04 a year ago, doubling from $0.04 last quarter.
